why_ai: Licensed transmitters, live local programming and local selling relationships protect the core, while automation, hubbing and audience erosion wear at the rest.
why_clarity: Logs, spots and rate cards recur daily and ratings arrive monthly, but pricing and programming are judged by feel.
why_digital: Content, ratings and logs are digital and playout runs on screens, but local advertisers are still sold face to face.

why_ai: The local owner buys the account executive's relationship, but search and social platforms with self-serve dashboards keep taking the budget.
why_clarity: Orders and airtimes are exact and renewals recur, but whether a schedule worked is rarely measured and sellers differ in method.
why_digital: Schedules, recaps and proposals are digital, but selling to local businesses still happens in person.

why_ai: A few executives negotiate high-stakes bilateral contracts on relationships and leverage, with contract and regulatory exposure.
why_clarity: Fees per subscriber are exact, but the deals recur only every few years and their quality is judged long after signing.
why_digital: Contracts, subscriber reports and models are documents and data, though negotiations still rely on executive relationships.

why_ai: Each renewal is an adversarial, high-stakes standoff whose outcome depends on judgement about the other side's breaking point.
why_clarity: There is no agreed method for valuing leverage, each negotiation is unique, and the result is clear only after a blackout ends or a deal closes.
why_digital: Analysis and offers are entirely digital, but the deal is closed between a few senior people.

why_ai: Reconciling reported counts against contracts and expectations is rule-based work that software can do.
why_clarity: An exact, checkable reconciliation repeated monthly for every system, with recoveries as fast feedback.
why_digital: Reports, contracts and models are files and data handled remotely.

why_ai: Hands-on work at remote transmitter sites, with licence exposure and a shrinking workforce, cannot be done by software.
why_clarity: Licensed parameters define success and faults are visible quickly, but diagnosis depends on each engineer's knowledge of the site.
why_digital: The work starts from physical equipment and ends with a signal on the air, with telemetry as the only digital part.

why_ai: Multi-year licence bets rest on relationships with syndicators and a programmer's judgement of what a show will do in a slot.
why_clarity: Ratings make the outcome measurable, but deals are infrequent, methods differ by programmer and the verdict takes a season.
why_digital: Ratings and deal models are digital, while negotiation runs by phone with distributors' sales staff.

why_ai: Major donors and members give to a station and people they trust, and demand for that relationship has grown since federal funding ended.
why_clarity: Dollars raised are measurable and drives recur, but cultivation of large gifts is relationship work with slow feedback.
why_digital: Membership data and email are digital, but on-air drives, events and donor meetings are local and personal.

why_ai: The PD's ear and format judgement carry weight, but music scheduling, voice-tracking and listening data steadily automate the role.
why_clarity: Music decisions recur weekly, but success is a matter of taste until monthly ratings or a test arrives, and methods vary by PD.
why_digital: Music logs, schedulers and ratings are all on screens, with relationships to labels and talent the main in-person element.

why_ai: Compiling public-file documents to fixed rules is mechanical, though the licensee still certifies and carries the exposure.
why_clarity: Each item has an exact rule and deadline, repeats across hundreds of licences, and late filings show up quickly.
why_digital: Rundowns, orders and the FCC file are all digital and handled remotely.

why_ai: Matching copy and resolving log conflicts is rule-governed screen work that extraction and optimisation software can absorb.
why_clarity: An exact, checkable log rebuilt every day, with discrepancies known within hours of air.
why_digital: Orders, copy instructions and logs are digital and traffic is already hubbed remotely.

why_ai: Stations buy the consultant's experience across markets and talent judgement, though survey work itself is automating.
why_clarity: Studies follow a method and recur by market, but the advice is judged on ratings that move for many reasons.
why_digital: Surveys and reports are digital, while talent coaching and strategy sessions are often in person.

why_ai: Clients value the researcher's interpretation, but online song testing and listening data are replacing the studies.
why_clarity: Music tests and perceptual surveys follow repeatable methods, with ratings as delayed, noisy feedback.
why_digital: Research is fielded online and delivered as reports to remote clients.

why_ai: Estimates modelled from public inputs are the kind of analytical product AI-native data services can reproduce.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checkable against later disclosures, but methods are proprietary and outcomes arrive slowly.
why_digital: Filings, deal data and forecasts are produced and sold entirely as digital data.

why_ai: Group executives rely on trusted researchers to read ratings and markets, but much of the reporting automates.
why_clarity: Ratings and revenue are measurable and reports recur, though programming judgements are partly taste.
why_digital: Ratings, traffic and revenue data are analysed on screens, with internal presentations to station leaders.

why_ai: Valuing stations in negotiation is adversarial and high-stakes, but the analysis itself is data work.
why_clarity: Costs and viewing are measurable, but the value of a station to subscribers is inferred and tested only by rare blackouts.
why_digital: Viewing data, contracts and models are digital and handled centrally.

why_ai: Market-by-market ratings presentations are routine analysis that automated tools can produce.
why_clarity: Ratings are exact and presentations recur by market each selling season.
why_digital: Ratings data and presentations are digital and shared remotely with station buyers.

why_ai: Weather data is increasingly model-generated, though severe-weather judgement and station trust still matter.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checked against observed weather within hours, and products recur continuously.
why_digital: Data feeds and graphics platforms are produced and delivered digitally.

why_ai: Advocacy before regulators and Congress depends on credibility and judgement in contested, novel proceedings.
why_clarity: Success is a policy outcome that may take years and depends on many actors.
why_digital: Filings and studies are digital, while advocacy relies on relationships in Washington.

why_ai: Collective negotiation for small operators is relationship-driven and adversarial.
why_clarity: Rates are measurable, but agreements are infrequent and their quality is judged over years.
why_digital: Contracts and subscriber data are digital; negotiation is between a few people.

why_ai: FCC exhibits are certified by accountable engineers, and site work and judgement on interference keep humans involved.
why_clarity: Exhibits follow FCC rules and propagation methods, with acceptance or rejection as clear feedback.
why_digital: Studies are computed from public data and filed electronically, with occasional site measurements.

why_ai: Automatic speech recognition is directly substituting human real-time captioning.
why_clarity: Caption accuracy and timing are measurable and the task is identical every hour.
why_digital: Audio in, text out, delivered as a remote digital service.

why_ai: Benchmarking and training are valued for peer trust, but benchmark compilation is routine.
why_clarity: Benchmarks are defined metrics compiled each year from station submissions.
why_digital: Data collection and reports are digital, with training partly in person.

why_ai: Remote fleet monitoring and fault analysis are data work, with field service the only hands-on part.
why_clarity: Faults and fixes are measurable and recur across the installed base.
why_digital: Telemetry is digital and support is delivered remotely, with occasional site visits.
